item.text: The available TTK build does not include its tensor-topology GUI filter, so I’m constructing the equivalent eigenvector-angle partition directly from the four tensor components and preserving it as a ParaView state plus a 1000×1000 render (10 pixels per unit square).

item.command: /bin/bash -lc '/opt/conda/bin/pvpython create_ocean_visualization.py'
/bin/bash -lc '/opt/conda/bin/pvpython create_ocean_visualization.py'

/bin/bash -lc "ls -lh Ocean_eigenvector_partition.* Ocean_degenerate_points.vtp && /opt/conda/bin/pvpython -c \"from paraview.simple import *; import os; print(os.path.getsize('/workspace/Ocean_eigenvector_partition.png'))\""

item.text: The scene has been rendered successfully at 1000×1000 pixels, with radius-1 glyphs and a categorical legend: white wedges and pink trisectors. I also saved the generated partition and points as reusable VTK datasets.
